notes: ROUTE: plain direct HTTPS to www.ikea.com/gb/en/ worked with an ordinary desktop UA - no proxy, no blocking, matching the prior Home-Decor pass. TREE SOURCE: IKEA's own mega-menu tree, taken from the site's embedded nav hydration payload (script type=text/hydrate on any /gb/en/cat/ page -> data.config.catalogSlim), which is the full 1,613-node GB category tree with id/name/url per node. The /gb/en/cat/furniture-fu001/ page is a 'Themes' marketing hub with subCategories:[] and is NOT a real department, so furniture was assembled from the real departments in catalogSlim: Tables & chairs (fu002), Living room seating (700640), Beds & mattresses (bm001), Storage furniture (st001), Office furniture (fu004), Bathroom furniture & storage (ba001), Outdoor living > Garden furniture (od003), Baby & children (bc001). QTY METHOD: for every one of the 112 leaves the exact product total came from IKEA's own listing backend sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/gb/en/product-list-page?category=<id> -> productListPage.productCount, and every single leaf was then verified two ways per Rule 1: (1) full enumeration - /product-list-page/more-products?category=<id>&start=0&end=productCount+50 returned exactly productCount tiles with exactly productCount unique itemNos (unique product IDs, not href counting); (2) boundary test - start=productCount-1 returned exactly 1 item and start=productCount returned 0 items, proving the total is neither truncated nor inflated. All 112 passed, 0 failures. RENDERED HEADER CROSS-CHECK: the /gb/en/cat/<slug>/ HTML header ('N items' in p.plp-filter-information__total-count, and 'Showing 24 of N results') was also read for all 112 leaves. It agrees exactly with productCount on 101 of 112. On 11 leaves the rendered header is 1-2 HIGHER (Coffee tables 45/44, Side tables 68/67, Beds 210/208, Fitted wardrobes 333/332, Sliding wardrobes 64/63, Hallway wardrobes 67/66, Chest of drawers 112/110, Bedside tables 58/57, Shoe cabinets 26/25, Hallway furniture sets 9/8, Children's wardrobes 13/12) because IKEA injects non-product 'planner' tool tiles into that headline count (productListPage.plannerCount). Since those tiles are not products and the enumeration + boundary test proves the real product total, the enumerated product count was used for those 11 rows and the header figure is recorded inside the evidence string. This also matches the method used by the prior validated Home-Decor pass on this same company. SANITY CHECKS: the h1 of every fetched page matched the requested category name; the API's own category.url echoed back matched the canonical URL used in 'link' for all 112; 57 distinct qty values across 112 leaves (range 1-332) so no site-wide constant; no suspiciously round display caps; a second read of 10 categories some minutes later returned identical numbers (no session drift). DEPTH RULE: descended to the deepest genuine product-type node but deliberately stopped at nodes whose only children are size / seat-count / material / colour / named-series splits, per the assignment. So Dining tables is a leaf (children are 2/4/6/8/10-seater size views plus table tops & underframes), Sofas is a leaf (2-seater/3-seater/chaise/corner/modular), Sofa beds is a leaf, Armchairs is a leaf (upholstered / leather / rattan are material views), Beds is a leaf (double/single are size views), Dining chairs is a leaf, Ottomans/footstools/pouffes is a leaf (fabric/rattan/leather are material views), Dining table sets is a leaf (up-to-2/4/6/8-seat size views). EXCLUDED - the entire 'Storage solution systems' branch (PAX, BESTA, PLATSA, EKET, TROFAST, SMASTAD, IVAR, BROR, BOAXEL, SKYTTA, JONAXEL, ELVARLI, OMAR, LADMAKARE, LASTARE, GULDDRAGARE) and the office 'Table & desk systems' branch (MITTZON, TROTTEN, IDASEN, RELATERA) and the bathroom 'Bathroom ranges' branch (HAVBACK, ANGSJON, TANNFORSEN, HEMNES, ENHET, NYSJON, VIDVESSEL) - these are named-series/system pages and are frames/doors/fronts/fittings component listings, excluded per the series rule and the Collections rule; the finished furniture they build is already covered by the type categories (e.g. PAX sits inside Fitted wardrobes, BESTA inside TV benches / Cabinets). ALSO EXCLUDED - Mattresses and all bedding/textiles (bm002, tl001, tl004, tl003), bed slats, mattress bases, bed legs, headboard/sofa/armchair/footstool covers, chair pads, chair covers, dining chair underframes & seat shells, dining table tops & underframes, sofa & armchair legs, knobs & handles (parts per the care/parts exclusion); Wall shelves (10398) and its children incl. floating shelves, cube wall shelves and display shelves & picture ledges (Wall Decor's job); storage boxes, baskets, bins, organisers, clothes/toy/ under-bed storage and Home storage & organisation st007 (standalone storage goods, a future Storage task); bathroom fixtures (sinks, taps, showers, countertops, bathroom accessories, bathroom shelves & towel rails) and bathroom mirrors proper; lighting of every kind incl. wardrobe/cabinet/integrated lighting; the whole Kitchens department ka001 (fitted kitchen systems, cabinet frames, doors & drawer fronts, worktops, splashbacks, appliances, sinks, taps) plus Kitchenettes 22957 whose listing mixes mini-kitchen units with taps and dish drainers - only Kitchen islands & trolleys was taken from it; Step stools & step ladders (20611, utility ladders); Garden sun shades (parasols, gazebos, pergolas, privacy screens - structures, not furniture); Outdoor kitchens and BBQs; laundry baskets, drying racks, ironing boards, washing machines; and all *-series 'Shop all/New/Best sellers/Clearance/Last chance' nav entries. INCLUDED WITH A FLAG - Mirror cabinets (20500): IKEA files it under Bathroom mirrors but the products are wall-mounted bathroom storage cabinets with mirrored doors, so it is bathroom storage furniture here (the prior Home-Decor pass excluded it from Mirrors for exactly this reason). Pantry, Basket drawer units, Garden storage and Bed and mattress sets are flagged where the listing is ambiguous or mixed. KNOWN OVERLAP (IKEA cross-cuts its own tree, kept and documented rather than dropped): Wardrobes is presented as three simultaneous cuts - solitaire/fitted, hinged/sliding/open, and location (hallway/corner/walk-in/reach-in/sloped ceiling/mirrored) - all eleven are separate site category IDs, not URL filter facets, so all were emitted and they overlap each other and sum well above the 516-product Wardrobes parent. Likewise Extendable dining tables and Round dining tables are siblings of Dining tables in IKEA's own Tables node and overlap it; Garden dining chairs appears in both Outdoor seating and Outdoor dining (emitted once, under Garden chairs). Duplicate nodes that IKEA lists under several parents (e.g. Bedside tables, Sideboards & buffets, Bathroom trolleys, Children's wardrobes) were each emitted exactly once, in the most truthful parent.
